name: SpatialBench
description: A large-scale, fine-grained benchmark covering 15 tasks aligned with hierarchical cognitive levels for evaluating multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on spatial cognition. Decomposes spatial intelligence into five progressively complex levels: observation (L1), topology and relation (L2), symbolic reasoning (L3), causality (L4), and planning (L5). Reveals that MLLMs exhibit strong perceptual grounding yet remain limited in symbolic reasoning, causal inference, and planning, while humans perform selective, goal-directed abstraction.
typical_sota_score: stratified across L1–L5; perception-level tasks near-saturated, symbolic/causal/planning levels well below human
reputation: A 2025/2026 multimodal spatial-cognition benchmark referenced by Epoch AI as an emblematic non-saturated multimodal reasoning benchmark; growing attention in the spatial-intelligence-in-VLM literature.
notes: Five-level hierarchical framework (observation → planning) exposes performance stratification across cognitive depth. Distinct from many existing 'spatial bench' variants in the data/benchmarks/ catalog (e.g., q_spatial_bench, refspatial_bench, embspatial_bench) — this is the SpatialBench specifically named in the Epoch AI post and at spicylemonade.github.io/spatialbench.
